data.title: Unit 3: The plant world
Photosynthesis
data.rubric: The study of plants is called botany.
Click on the plant to know how photosynthesis takes place.
data.text: The process by which plants make their food is called photosynthesis.
Plants collect water from the ground and energy from the Sun.
Plants breathe in carbon dioxide from the air.
Photosynthesis takes place in the leaves.
Leaves contain a substance called chlorophyll.
Chlorophyll acts on sunlight to make it suitable for use in the process of photosynthesis.
When the changed sunlight is mixed with carbon dioxide and water, it makes a type of sugar called glucose.
Glucose is the food that helps the plant to grow.
The oxygen leaves the plant and goes into the air.
